title: Buffs - Nuka Cola Product Buffs
blurb: Every Nuka-Cola product and what it really does, straight from the game files. Find the best one for your build, compare up to three side by side, or open any of them for its buffs, side effects and when it works.

basics.title: Nuka-Cola basics
lines: Most Nuka-Cola products give you radiation. The amount is shown with each one.
Products with the same kind of buff replace each other. Products with different buffs stack.
